message: Last winter, I decided to finally sort through the pantry, and wouldn’t you know, I found a stash of canned soups I’d forgotten about. When the snowstorm hit and we were snowed in for days, I felt like a genius as I ladled out warm bowls of tomato bisque. It was a small win that turned a chilly inconvenience into a cozy family dinner. Sometimes, a little prep goes a long way, doesn’t it? ☕
